gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 13 build still replays the current devres helper packet, so the survey boundary should stay tied to the same bounded checkpoint as the rest of the tranche.
The existing make target keeps the helper-first devres survey packet runnable through the same repeatable route as the rest of the Phase 13 helper work.
The landed helper lab already covers bounded __devm_ioremap() lifetime planning and exact devm_iounmap() pointer matching without claiming live teardown parity.
The dedicated devres tests keep the helper-only packet honest around managed acquire cleanup, resource-backed planning, devm_of_iomap() replay, and memtype bookkeeping.
A focused reviewability gate keeps the helper-only DMA/scatterlist boundary machine-checkable even while the shipped helper packet remains narrower than live devres ownership.
The slice note keeps the narrow helper-first boundary explicit so the lane does not overclaim live devres, MMIO, DMA, or scatterlist parity.
The survey note now records the current helper foothold together with the explicit DMA/scatterlist non-goals the roadmap still requires this lane to keep blocked.

The helper lab already carries the bounded __devm_ioremap_resource() planner for memory-backed resource checks, inclusive size calculation, pretty-name shaping, busy-region failures, and remap cleanup without claiming live reservations.
The landed devm_of_iomap() planner keeps translated-resource selection, optional size reporting, and downstream planner failure shaping reviewable before any live device-tree ownership is attempted.

The current devm_arch_io_reserve_memtype_wc() helper records WC release bookkeeping and failure shaping while keeping live arch memtype mutation outside the shipped packet and leaving arch_io_free_memtype_wc() as detach-time intent only.

The landed devm_arch_phys_wc_add() token planner records retained removal tokens on success and failure cleanup on negative token returns while keeping arch_phys_wc_del() reviewable and out of live side-effect territory.
Live MMIO mappings remain blocked because the roadmap still wants Phase 13 devres work to stay helper-first and reviewable instead of claiming real region mutation or address-space effects.

Live DMA-backed helpers remain blocked because the current helper packet does not model dmam_alloc_* ownership or live DMA mapping state, and the roadmap still prefers bounded reviewability over premature DMA parity.
Live scatter-gather ownership remains blocked because the current helper lab does not own sg_table or sg_* lifecycle state and should keep scatterlist behavior outside the shipped packet.
Live device-tree walking remains blocked because the current devm_of_iomap() slice only models translated-resource selection by index and should not pretend to own OF lookup or node lifetime.
Live arch memtype state remains blocked because the current WC helpers stop at bookkeeping and error shaping rather than mutating the real arch memtype token or release path.
